name: AlphaFold Structure Prediction
description: Predict a protein structure or complex with AlphaFold2 (ColabFold) on Delta@NCSA. Paste a sequence or upload a FASTA/A3M, then inspect the 3D model, pLDDT and PAE in the structure viewer.

customFields.label: Sequence
customFields.help: FASTA record or raw amino-acid sequence. Separate the chains of a complex with ':' (CHAIN_A:CHAIN_B). Optional when a file is uploaded or an Input Path is given.

customFields.label: Upload FASTA / A3M
customFields.help: Single file (max 5MB), uploaded to the cluster before the job starts. Takes precedence over the pasted sequence. An .a3m skips the MSA server.

customFields.label: Input Path on Cluster
customFields.help: FASTA/A3M file (or a directory of them) already on Delta. Used only when nothing is pasted or uploaded; relative paths resolve under the Diamond working directory.

customFields.label: Output Directory
customFields.placeholder: Defaults to outputs/<task name> in the Diamond working directory
customFields.help: ColabFold writes the ranked PDB models, score JSONs and plots here. Relative paths resolve under the Diamond working directory.

customFields.label: AlphaFold Container (.sif)
customFields.help: ColabFold Apptainer image on the cluster (.sif file or sandbox directory).

customFields.label: AlphaFold2 Weights Cache
customFields.help: Directory containing colabfold/params (the AlphaFold2 weights). Leave empty only if the weights were baked into the image.

customFields.label: Models (1-5)
customFields.help: Fewer models finish faster; 5 gives the best ranking.

customFields.label: Recycles
customFields.help: More recycles can improve accuracy at the cost of runtime.

optional.label: auto (ptm for monomers, multimer_v3 for complexes)

customFields.label: MSA Mode

optional.label: Single sequence (no MSA: fast, low accuracy)

customFields.help: MMseqs2 modes query the public ColabFold MSA server, so the compute node needs outbound internet. Upload an .a3m to skip the server.

optional.label: Relax the top-ranked model (OpenMM/Amber on GPU)
